Ember has been lovingly hand-raised since she was just 9 days old, and watching her personality blossom has been an absolute joy. This little girl is spunky, silly, smart, and wonderfully adventurous! She’s brave, curious, and always ready to explore something new. She approaches life with enthusiasm and a playful spirit that makes it nearly impossible not to smile when she’s around. But there’s another side to Ember that’s just as special. After she’s finished playing, exploring, and entertaining everyone around her, she loves nothing more than settling in for a good snuggle. She’ll curl up close, get comfortable, and drift off to sleep, perfectly content to be near her people. Ember has that wonderful combination of adventurous spirit and affectionate heart. She’s the kind of puppy who will fill your days with laughter and your quiet moments with love. We’ve had the privilege of loving Ember for almost her entire life. Now we’re hoping to find someone who will treasure all the wonderful things that make her her. Ember isn’t just looking for a home. She’s looking for her person, her adventures, and her happily ever after. 🐾💕

highlights.text: Lovingly hand-raised since he was just 9 days old, Otis has grown into the sweetest, most gentle little boy, with a personality that is every bit as beautiful as his adorable fluffy face.

dogs.fosterBio: 💙 Meet Otis — A Gentle Soul With a Heart Full of Love! 💙 Some puppies steal your heart with their big personalities. Others have a quieter, gentler way of finding their way into it. Otis is one of those special little souls. Lovingly hand-raised since he was just 9 days old, Otis has grown into the sweetest, most gentle little boy, with a personality that is every bit as beautiful as his adorable fluffy face. Otis absolutely loves to play! He can be silly, rambunctious, and full of puppy energy when the moment calls for it. But what makes him especially wonderful is his ability to settle down and simply enjoy being close to the people he loves. He’ll snuggle up beside you, get perfectly comfortable, and happily stay there until you’re ready to move. He doesn’t need constant entertainment or excitement. Sometimes, just being near you is enough. Otis is incredibly smart and curious, but he has a thoughtful way of approaching the world. While other puppies might rush headfirst into something new, Otis often prefers to sit back, watch, and take it all in first. It’s almost as though he’s quietly figuring everything out, with a wisdom that seems far beyond his young age. And when he’s ready, he’ll join the fun! There’s something incredibly endearing about his gentle spirit. He’s playful without needing to be the loudest, curious without needing to be first, and affectionate in the most genuine, comforting way. We’ve had the privilege of loving Otis since he was a tiny, helpless newborn. Watching him grow into this sweet, thoughtful little boy has been such a gift. Now it’s time for someone else to discover just how wonderful he is. Otis doesn’t need to be the center of your world. He just wants to be a part of it. And somehow, he’ll end up becoming the center of your heart. 🐾💙

Takes me a little bit to settle but after that as long as things stay quiet I’m quiet too. If I hear action someplace though, I’ll sing until somebody comes to get me - foster mom says I’m very operatic. I say I have serious FOMO. If you’re looking for a beautiful, soft, smart companion, I’ve got ALL THAT. Come see me!
